import.title: Import from UID
import.hint: Imports the characters in the in-game showcase (with details visible), with their equipped weapons and artifacts. Data from <enka>Enka.network</enka>.
import.uidInvalid: Enter a UID with 9 or 10 digits.
import.empty: The showcase is empty, or character details are hidden in the game settings.
import.loaded_one: {{count}} character in the showcase, with weapons and artifacts. Check the preview below and confirm the import.
import.loaded_other: {{count}} characters in the showcase, with weapons and artifacts. Check the preview below and confirm the import.
import.skipped: Not recognized (maybe too new for this version): {{list}}.
import.network: Can't read the showcase: check your connection and try again.

errors.424: Enka.network is under maintenance after a game update: try again later.
errors.429: Too many requests: wait a minute and try again.
errors.503: Enka.network is not responding: try again later.

import.hintAkasha: Imports every build saved on <akasha>Akasha</akasha> (also of characters no longer in the showcase), several per character: each becomes a Genshin Optimizer build (weapon and 5 artifacts) in the character's build menu, on the Teams page. The “current” build, or the latest, stays equipped.
import.akashaProgress: Reading artifacts from Akasha: {{done}} of {{total}} builds…
import.akashaEmpty: Akasha has no builds for this UID: open the profile on akasha.cv to create and refresh it, then try again.
import.akashaLoaded_one: {{count}} character with {{builds}} builds. Check the preview below and confirm the import.
import.akashaLoaded_other: {{count}} characters with {{builds}} builds. Check the preview below and confirm the import.
import.akashaNetwork: Cannot read from Akasha: check the connection and try again.

akashaErrors.400: The JuanLab Worker does not know Akasha yet: update it with the new worker.js (tools/enka-proxy).
akashaErrors.404: Akasha does not know this UID: open the profile on akasha.cv to create it, then try again.
akashaErrors.429: Too many requests to Akasha: wait a minute and try again.
akashaErrors.502: Akasha did not answer with data (maybe its bot check): try again later.

home.intro: The <gi>Genshin Impact</gi> build calculator by <juanlab>JuanLab</juanlab>, based on Stellar Optimizer and Genshin Optimizer. Import your characters with your UID (Enka or Akasha), find the best build with what you have and simulate team rotations, beta characters included.
home.importHint: Loads the characters in your showcase, with equipped weapons and artifacts, into the current database. You'll see a preview of what changes before saving. Character details must be visible in the game.

gcweb.title: Link to gc-web
gcweb.hint: gc-web is the LunaGC panel on your PC. When the link is on, the character page shows “Send to gc-web” (the equipped artifacts become a CharacterBuilder build); builds (“Open in Juan-optimizer”) and your account's characters (“Export the characters to Juan-optimizer”) sent from gc-web open here ready to import. When it is off, incoming links are ignored.
gcweb.sendTitle: Open gc-web with this character's equipped artifacts, ready to save as a CharacterBuilder build
gcweb.noArtifacts: This character has no equipped artifacts to send.
gcweb.incomingOff: A link arrived from gc-web, but the link is off. Turn it on in Settings → Database → Upload, under “Link to gc-web”, then open the link from gc-web again.
gcweb.incomingBad: The link from gc-web does not hold a valid build or characters.

gcweb.skipped_other: {{count}} pieces not recognized were left out.
gcweb.accountSkipped_one: {{count}} unrecognized item (character, weapon or artifact, maybe too new for this version) was left out.
gcweb.accountSkipped_other: {{count}} unrecognized items (characters, weapons or artifacts, maybe too new for this version) were left out.

beta.notice: Beta {{label}} content (kits from {{source}}, from the beta dump): provisional numbers that can change before release.

kqmCompare.title: KQM Compare
kqmCompare.alphaTip: Experimental: it may change, and its results need checking, between versions.
kqmCompare.info: Compares KQM Theorycrafting's result (A) with the same team with one member replaced (B). Only the entering member's build is searched; the others keep A's builds, constellations and settings. Nothing is saved.
kqmCompare.noResultTip: KQM Compare starts from this team's last KQM Theorycrafting result: generate builds there first.
kqmCompare.fixedTip: Locked: in B they keep A's builds, constellations and settings.
kqmCompare.autoTip: Weapon and sets chosen by the KQM search, among those allowed in KQM Theorycrafting's settings. Without Auto, choose a weapon and 4 pieces of one set or 2 + 2.
kqmCompare.buildExistingTip: Not available yet: for now the entering member gets a KQM build.
kqmCompare.settingsTip: The options KQM Theorycrafting has for a member, for this comparison only. Field time is the leaving member's.
kqmCompare.settingsNeedSwap: Choose who leaves and write the fragment
kqmCompare.fragmentTip: Only the entering member's actions (e.g. E Q): they replace the leaving member's step in KQM Theorycrafting's rotation.
kqmCompare.confirm: The data in KQM Theorycrafting (result of {{date}}) are final
kqmCompare.rotationChanged: The rotation changed after KQM Theorycrafting's result: A was worked out on the previous one.

need.gear: Choose weapon and set, or Auto
need.confirm: Confirm that A's data are final

error.noRotation: No rotation written in KQM Theorycrafting.
error.repeated: {{name}} appears {{count}} times in the rotation: the comparison needs a single step.
error.unsupported: This choice is not available yet.

kqmCompare.notPlayed: KQM Theorycrafting's result uses the entered attacks, not the written rotation: A and B are not worked out the same way.
kqmCompare.effectsTip: As in KQM Theorycrafting: the effects on for the entering member. Those left alone follow KQM's rules (rotation B and the team's elements).
kqmCompare.weaponEnergyTip: How much less Energy Recharge the entering member needs while someone in team B wields this weapon, as in KQM Theorycrafting's weapon list.
